notes: Geometry is px in the 1080×1920 frame, origin top-left; center is [x, y].

Sizes: B1 and B11's slots are 320 wide (the halves' quarter turn sweeps a circle of radius 199 px about their centers, which is what fits between x 140 and 940); the swept sheet in B2–B4 is 400 wide; the proof pair in B4–B8 is 310 wide each; the real A4 in B9 is 360 wide and the A3 in B10 is 509 × 720.

Vertical use: B1's notes sit under the sheets; B2–B4's sheet sits on y 1052 above compareNote; B5–B6's pair sits low (bottoms y 952) and B7 lifts it to y 833.4 so the equation row fits under it; B9–B10 fill y 370–1154.

Compositions center on x 540 and keep all ink, labels and every moving shape's whole sweep within x 140–940, y ≥ 240. check-render wants both the whole ink and the picture without edge labels within ±25 px of x 540 at each beat end, so the proof pairs (B4–B8) sit a few px right of group-center, and the A3 label goes below its outline.
Draw order is declaration order across the episode (Mismatch beneath its two sheets). The loop depends on it: a4Ghost draws beneath a4Half at frame 0, and a3 beneath page at the end.

The loop: B11's last frame must equal B1's frame 0 (dashed ghosts, teal lower halves, names A4 and 레터, no notes). a3 ends as a4Ghost's box, page ends as a4Half's box with name 'A4', letterGhost2 and letterHalf2 copy sheet and half's frame-0 props. Every prop that draws pixels must match: stroke, dashed, fillOpacity, strokeWidth, names.

check-render will warn 'readable' at the end: the page's 'A4' and letterHalf2's '레터' are fully visible only for the last few frames. Expected: the loop continues them into frame 0, where both are visible.
Comparisons match heights (standAndFit match 'height'), because B6 explains the fit that way: grow the folded half x times until the heights meet, then the widths must meet too.

√2 = 1.4142; Letter h/w = 11/8.5 = 1.2941. The ideal sheet (h/w = √2) also stands for the real A4 in B9–B10: 210 × 297 mm differs from it by under 0.1 px at this size, which is why B9 says the difference in words (≈ 0.3 mm) instead of drawing it.
Nothing shows a number until B4. The sweep shows only the gap. The top ratio note leaves at B5 and returns, with √2, in B8.

Every exit is a 0.2 s fade; an appear sharing its anchor with exits waits for them. Handoffs between elements with identical boxes (page over sheet in B10) put the appear and the exit on different anchors, so there is no blink.
B7's word '이' has no audible onset in this take (20 ms in the alignment), so no cue is anchored on it; only the caption chunk starts there.

Edge colors follow the role, not the physical edge: yellow is a sheet's long side (its height, since every compared sheet stands upright), blue its short side (width). So the original's short side is blue '1' while the same edge, as the folded half's height, is yellow '1'. The reasoning is height against height, width against width, which role colors show directly.

components.name: PaperRect
components.spec: As built for this episode: v1's actions plus standAndFit {ref, match: width|height, follow}, setStyle dashed and page, the page prop. Unchanged this round.

components.name: Note
components.spec: As built: one line of text with $…$ math at `at`; appear, exit, setText (token morph).

components.name: Mismatch
components.spec: As built (the red symmetric difference of two live sheets, beneath both; production is raising its fill to a clearly red, higher-contrast style). New action pulse: over the cue's span the shaded region flashes (bump 0 → 1 → 0) to full opacity and back, with a 4 px outline in the same color that fades with the flash. Used once, on '이쪽만' in B1, together with a4Half's pulse.

components.name: Equation
components.spec: As built: parts, reveal, transformTo token morphs (x^2 is x plus a superscript 2; \sqrt{...} wraps its radicand's tokens), box, exit, and reveal fromLabel {of, side}: exactly one part, which starts as that sheet's edge label as drawn the frame before and flies, growing, into its slot; the player takes the label off the sheet on the same frame. The label's TeX must render like the part in the display-style row (B7: \dfrac{x}{2}\times x for \frac{x}{2} \times x; 1 for 1).

components.name: Dimension
components.spec: As built (v1 spec): measurement line along a sheet's edge with a label beyond it; tracks the sheet.
